hero.title: Bitcoin holds above $80,000 after Wednesday’s jump as injective rallies on staked ETF listing
hero.description: Bitcoin slipped 0.2% to around $80,250 since midnight UTC, holding above $80,000 after Wednesday’s jump, as spot ETFs ended a three-day outflow streak.

latest.title: World's largest olive oil company plummets 19% after rivals agree to takeover deal
latest.description: The world's largest olive oil company, Deoleo, plummeted in early trading after two of its rivals announced plans to acquire the firm.

latest.title: How the midterms could fuel the K-shaped AI trade
latest.description: U.S. midterm results could slow data center development, raising the value of existing AI capacity while increasing pressure on debt-funded neoclouds.

latest.title: Consumers are spending on physical gifts even as travel tops wish lists, Visa survey finds
latest.description: Even as travel and experiences top the wish list, consumers are still prioritizing spending on physical gifts this holiday season.

latest.title: Live updates: Bitcoin steady around $80,000 as markets rally after Democratic sweep
latest.description: Ether jumped 4% and crypto ETFs drew fresh money after Wall Street turned higher and Brent crude fell nearly 9%.

latest.title: Mercado Bitcoin hack continued hours after exchange said attack was contained, report finds
latest.description: The same attacker took about $391,000, mostly from wallets Bitquery ties to BitMart, whose founder confirmed a Nov. 2 hack and suspects a link.

latest.title: Arkansas Sues Kalshi, Joining a Growing List of States Targeting Prediction Markets
latest.description: Attorney General Tim Griffin said betting on "whether the Razorbacks win or lose" is gambling, and wants restitution, penalties and taxes.

latest.title: Bitcoin win rate vs. S&P 500 recovers as post-midterm history favors stocks
latest.description: Bitcoin outperformed the S&P 500 in half of the past 90 US trading sessions, while historical midterm data highlights gains for stocks.

latest.title: OpenAI pledges to pay for data center power after election highlights AI concerns
latest.description: OpenAI pledged to solicit community input around AI data centers, publish construction plans and protect ratepayers.

latest.title: Bitcoin miner Riot could pay Anthropic 12% interest under $28 billion AI deal
latest.description: Riot has sold most of its bitcoin to fund its move into data centers. Its latest agreement gives Anthropic a way to finance part of the build and collect interest through rent deductions.

latest.title: South Korea seeks 4th crypto tax delay, targets 2029 start
latest.description: South Korea is seeking a fourth delay to its 22% crypto tax, months after reaffirming plans to begin taxing digital asset gains in January 2027.

latest.title: Rheinmetall shares plunge 17% after outlook cut as military contracts stall
latest.description: Rheinmetall cut its 2026 outlook for the second time in three months, citing delays to German military projects and artillery ammunition deliveries.

latest.title: France budget rejection sidelines stablecoin tax, wallet reporting
latest.description: Three adopted amendments, including stablecoin taxation and self-custody reporting, fall away but could be reintroduced in the Senate.

latest.title: Hong Kong passes law requiring crypto exchanges to report customer transactions to tax authorities
latest.description: Crypto firms must collect customer and transaction data from 2027, with Hong Kong sharing the information with overseas tax authorities from 2028.

latest.title: OpenAI says its AI can break into Linux at scale. Here's what it means for crypto
latest.description: OpenAI says its AI found 948 Linux flaws and wrote a working attack for each one. Crypto security voices say decentralization leaves the industry better placed than most to cope.

latest.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs draw $128M as crypto rebounds after midterms
latest.description: Fidelity led Bitcoin ETF inflows, while BlackRock’s IBIT shed another $201 million, extending its outflow streak to four trading sessions.

latest.title: From tanks to drones: South Korea’s defense firms face a new battlefield test
latest.description: South Korean defense stocks rode a wave of global rearmament for the past two years, but they have plunged in 2026.

latest.title: Nintendo Switch 2 sales plunge 41% as price hikes and memory crunch bite
latest.description: Sales of Nintendo's flagship Switch 2 plunged in its fiscal second quarter after the Japanese gaming giant rolled out price hikes amid soaring memory costs.

latest.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa resumes operations after attack, assesses losses
latest.description: The bank said customer funds were unaffected after attackers accessed its systems through a service provider’s platform.

latest.title: NextDC shares soar nearly 51% after Goodman, Digital Realty stake purchases
latest.description: NextDC shares surged nearly 51% Thursday morning after Goodman Group and Digital Realty sought to acquire up to a 9.9% stake.
